## FC Dallas Lineup Prediction [...] I also loved the way the defense looked with Shaq Moore at left wingback and Nolan Norris in. So factoring in the long travel of Bernie Kamungo and Ran Binyamin, I’ve got Norris and Herman Johansson in too. (On the other hand, both are youthful and Quill love him some Bernie, so I could be totally wrong.)

Daniel, off the injury list, also in.

3rd Degree's FC Dallas XI prediction at Charlotte FC, Oct 10, 2026. 

3rd Degree’s FC Dallas XI prediction at Charlotte FC, Oct 10, 2026. [...] 3rd in the West FC Dallas (47 points, 13-6-8) travels east to take on 5th in the East Charlotte FC (43 points, 12-8-7) at Bank of America Stadium. Kickoff is set for 6:30 pm CT, but weather is going to be a factor.

These two teams have never met in MLS play. Their only previous matchup occurred in Leagues  
Cup 2023, where Charlotte defeated FC Dallas in penalties 4-1 in the group stage (July 21).

Charlotte needs to fill the position normally occupied by center back Tim Ream, whose third red card of the season in the last match means he’s suspended for this outing vs. Dallas. Andrew Privett might fill that spot, though he hasn’t been in action for Charlotte for more than two months.

Rain is likely in the forecast for this match.
